page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs provided by a Hygon 7447v processor operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The CPU flags indicate a lack of advanced vector extensions, matrix extensions, and hardware-assisted cryptography or virtualization flags.

With a compute-oriented 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without massive memory footprints. It is suitable for compute-bound tasks, batch processing, web serving, and lightweight application hosting where local storage is not required and network demands do not exceed the 4 Gbps baseline.
